name: NTIRE 2024 Short-form UGC VQA (KVQ)
description: This paper reviews the NTIRE 2024 Challenge on Shortform UGC Video Quality Assessment (S-UGC VQA), where various excellent solutions are submitted and evaluated on the collected dataset KVQ from popular short-form video platform, i.e., Kuaishou/Kwai Platform. The KVQ database is divided into three parts, including 2926 videos for training, 420 videos for validation, and 854 videos for testing. The purpose is to build new benchmarks and advance the development of S-UGC VQA. The competition had 200 participants and 13 teams submitted valid solutions for the final testing phase. The proposed solutions achieved state-of-the-art performances for S-UGC VQA. The project can be found at https://github.com/lixinustc/KVQChallenge-CVPR-NTIRE2024.
evaluation_method: SRCC / PLCC / RMSE (rank and linear correlation plus error metrics commonly reported)
reputation: Well-known within the image/video quality assessment community due to being used in the NTIRE 2024 challenge and attracting many participants.
notes: Medium-sized dataset (~4.2k videos total). Challenge-format evaluations can produce tuned solutions that risk overfitting to platform-specific artifacts (Kuaishou); not an LLM benchmark.
